mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,invocation_id,caller_task_id,step_id,record_version,binding_digest,input_digest,authority_digest, graph_digest,context_digest,normalized_snapshot,normalized_digest,normalized_bytes,outcome,failure_code, scan_digest,node_count,edge_count,proof_reads,proof_bytes,output_digest,output_bytes,receipt_event_seq, committed_attempt_id,committed_fence,committed_at,content_state,'TRACE' AS operation,NULL AS native_read_seq FROM invocation_session_lineage_trace WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE invocation_session_lineage_trace SET outcome=#{commit.outcome},failure_code=#{commit.code}, scan_digest=#{commit.scan},node_count=#{commit.lineage.nodes},edge_count=#{commit.lineage.edges}, proof_reads=#{commit.lineage.reads},proof_bytes=#{commit.lineage.bytes},output_digest=#{commit.outputDigest}, output_bytes=#{commit.outputBytes},receipt_event_seq=#{commit.receipt},committed_attempt_id=#{attempt}, committed_fence=#{fence},committed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{id} AND outcome='PENDING' AND content_state='PRESENT'
